entities.name: Dans Ločmelis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dans Ločmelis is a Latvian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Providence Bruins of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has also played for Luleå HF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL) and HK Mogo of Latvian Hockey Higher League (LHL). He played college ice hockey at UMass Amherst.
